proposed_fix.description: Check currencyservice socket and connection state (connection-pool and file-descriptor limits, network policy or sidecar issues). Scale out currencyservice replicas to absorb the load, and fix the socket or connection misconfiguration. Do a rolling restart only if inspection confirms leaked connections.
